title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Report Extension Examples & Use Cases
summary: This post is an index page for a blog series on report extensions in Business Central. It only lists linked articles with short teasers, covering the ReportExtension object (BC18), pictures, comments and notes on reports, PDF passwords, sorting, request page defaults, Report.TargetFormat (BC26), custom export filenames (BC25), report substitution and regional settings per report (BC22).
key_points: The page is a link list; the technical details live in the linked articles.
Articles cover the ReportExtension object and adding Media/MediaSet pictures, comments and FactBox notes to reports.
Output topics include PDF passwords, Report.TargetFormat, custom filenames for exports and disabling print or preview.
Request page articles cover changing default options and filters and adding actions.
One article explains why fields added through a report extension are missing from layouts exported from the Report Layouts page.
